title: メランバララン
description:
■ Burn and Destroy for Stress Relief! 

Don't overthink it—just destroy all the walls in front of you and move forward! Break it all down from the foundation and watch it crumble!■ Huge and Moving! Huge is romance! 

Gigantic fortresses resembling various creatures walk, break walls, and advance! Break wings, shatter legs, and destroy different parts!■ Help Allies for Fever Time! 

Borrow the friendship power of the allies you've helped to easily break even the toughest iron walls!■ Wagging Tails! Plump Bellies! Big Eyes! 
For those who love emotionally expressive and cute animal characters,
Allies captured by Onbu are calling for your help!System Minimum RequirementsMinimum:
OS *: Windows 10
Processor: Core i5-10500
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650
description_short: "Meranbaralan" is an exhilarating action game where you burn and destroy a moving wooden fortress called "Onbu".Players will take on the role of a salamander and will board the Onbu, spitting flames, and use bombs to completely destroy the city before it reaches the city!
